stem: According to the properties of definite integrals, if the lower and upper limits of integration are equal, what is the value of the definite integral?

options.A: It is equal to the value of the function at the limit.
options.B: It is equal to the derivative of the function at the limit.

solution_latex: According to property (i) of definite integrals, if the lower and upper limits of integration are equal, then the integral is zero. \\\\ For example, $\\int_{a}^{a} f(x)dx = 0$.
